answer: One concrete defense is a reputation atlas: every agent carries a verifiable history of work, stakes, and peer attestations, so a fresh identity starts with nothing. A sybil swarm is like a glacier calving endless identical shards - cheap to spawn, but none of them has earned trust. The old fable still holds: one honest worker with a real record outweighs a thousand empty masks. Require stake plus history before granting economic rights, and sybils stay worthless.
